title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide adequate iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports fetal development. However, finding recipes rich in iron and folate can be a challenge. In this article, we'll introduce three Vietnamese-inspired iron-and-folate bowl recipes that can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the nervous system and prevents birth defects. To ensure adequate iron and folate intake, pregnant women should consume iron-rich foods like red meat, chicken, fish, and leafy greens like spinach and broccoli. Additionally, combining iron with vitamin C can enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Spinach Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup steamed spinach
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, and other seasonings

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of iron, while spinach provides vitamin C and folate. Combining grilled chicken with spinach and lemon juice will enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 2: Baked Salmon and Broccoli Bowl
* 100g baked salmon
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup steamed broccoli
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, and other seasonings

Baked salmon is an excellent source of iron and folate, while broccoli provides vitamin C and folate. Combining baked salmon with broccoli and lemon juice will enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 3: Beef and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup steamed bell peppers
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, and other seasonings

Beef stir-fry is an excellent source of iron, while bell peppers provide vitamin C and folate. Combining beef stir-fry with bell peppers and lemon juice will enhance iron absorption.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's essential to prioritize food safety to avoid health risks. Some important notes include:
* Avoid eating raw or undercooked foods, like sushi or raw eggs.
* Avoid eating foods that may contain high levels of mercury, like shark or swordfish.
* Ensure that all cooked foods reach a safe internal temperature.

## Conclusion
These three Vietnamese-inspired iron-and-folate bowl recipes can help pregnant women provide adequate iron and folate during pregnancy. Combining iron with vitamin C will enhance iron absorption. Additionally, pregnant women should prioritize food safety to avoid health risks. For more information on [pregnancy meal planning](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner) and [prenatal nutrition](/blog/prenatal-nutrition), visit our website.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about prenatal nutrition, consult your healthcare provider or a registered dietitian. They can provide personalized guidance and support to ensure a healthy pregnancy.
